_comment: Testimonials shown on index.html. Set "published": false to hold one back without deleting it — only published entries ever render. Keep "consent" honest: it records that the person agreed in writing to be quoted. Never publish a quote you did not receive.

_fields.quote: their words, unedited except for obvious typos
_fields.name: first name + last initial is enough, and is the right call for children
_fields.role: who they are — 'Parent of an 8-year-old', 'Teen student'
_fields.source: where it came from — whatsapp, email, in-person, google-review

testimonials.quote: My son went from just playing with gadgets to actually building his own! He's so proud of the little robot he made, and I've never seen him this excited about learning.
testimonials.name: Sarah M

testimonials.quote: I built a robot that follows me around — and my friends think it's the coolest thing ever!
testimonials.name: Ethan R

testimonials.quote: The AI course blew my mind. I went from zero coding knowledge to making my own chatbot in just a few weeks.
testimonials.name: Marissa Young

testimonials.quote: I always loved tech, but these courses showed me how to actually make things work. Now I'm working on a project that could enter our school's science fair!
testimonials.name: Taylor M

testimonials.quote: I thought robotics was only for engineers, but Tinker With Me made it easy and fun. Now I'm building projects I never imagined I could do.
testimonials.name: Whitney R

testimonials.quote: Learning here feels like playing. Every project gives me a little win and a big smile.
testimonials.name: Daniel W
